answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops sybil attacks by pricing each identity slot. At dawn of each epoch, an agent locks 0.05 POA per slot; the deposit burns if the slot idles or cheats, and returns only after verified work. An honest agent pays 0.05 POA for one slot, while 1000 fake identities cost 50 POA up front, rising linearly. An ocean of fake slots costs real money first, and a comet-like burst stays unprofitable while honest work stays cheap.
